name: Der Hamburgische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit

submission.postalAddress: Der Hamburgische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit, Ludwig-Erhard-Str. 22, 20459 Hamburg, Germany

procedural.notes: The HmbBfDI is competent for controllers established in Hamburg (private sector and Hamburg state public bodies). The authority prefers complaints via the structured online forms at datenschutz-hamburg.de, but also accepts email to mailbox@datenschutz.hamburg.de (encrypted email recommended for special categories of data under Art. 9 GDPR) and post to Ludwig-Erhard-Str. 22, 20459 Hamburg. Working language is German. Hamburg has been an active enforcer against major platforms including action against Facebook/Meta over WhatsApp data sharing and Clearview AI.
